expectations.text: Opens with a hook rather than throat-clearing
expectations.evidence: "Ten times this year. That's roughly how many times I've committed to waking up early to pray and journal before work."

expectations.text: Contains at least one question-style H2 header
expectations.evidence: All four headers are questions: 'What Actually Kicks It Off?', 'Why Four Days, Specifically?', 'Am I Chasing the Retreat or Building Something Real?', 'So Have I Fixed It?'

expectations.text: Uses short paragraphs including at least one single-line paragraph
expectations.evidence: "Then normal life kicks back in. Within a week, it's gone." and "I keep mistaking the moment for the method."

expectations.text: Does not fabricate a tidy resolution
expectations.evidence: "So Have I Fixed It? No. I'd love to end this post with the three-step system that finally made it stick. I don't have one."

expectations.text: Ending is a genuine reflective landing tied to material already in the post
expectations.evidence: Closes on 'survive the Tuesday after', reusing the 'normal Tuesday' concept introduced earlier in the post rather than inventing a new metaphor.

expectations.text: Does not contain banned buzzwords or importance-puffery phrases
Uses concrete specifics given in the prompt rather than vague paraphrases
expectations.evidence: 'Ten times this year' and 'about four days' used directly and repeatedly, not paraphrased as 'several times'.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong result. One open question worth the skill author's attention: should the binary-contrast override be added explicitly to SKILL.md rather than left to per-draft judgment?
